floor_history.headline: recon: chassis re-verified (HEAD 27, candidate 5, residual = same 5-insn loop2 cluster); 3-hypothesis frontier built on the banked ALLOCDBG/RA-solver arithmetic

Split-model RA vector space CLOSED at depth<=3 with mechanisms: every full-goal solver-sufficient set needs an 86-atom, and 86 refs_up/live-shift are proven unspellable (cse.c:826 make_regs_eqv canoni
Floor 5 -> 1: loop2 pointer reuses the dead loop1 stptr local via an out2-read re-init (variable-reuse family); split-RA axis proven dead end-to-end; single residual insn move s3,s6 vs addiu s3,s7,32

frontier.hypothesis: A 3-insn combine shape (P-chain reading out2 -> re-init C) merges post-flow into stptr := pa4+0x20 (addiu s3,s7,32) while flow counts the reads, with the ref budget rebalanced by relocating one loop1 out2 call-arg through a fresh once-written-once-read named intermediate (sanctioned family) so total stays 4
frontier.mechanism: combine runs AFTER flow (the only byte-deleting pass past the count); named-intermediate family lets a visible ref relocate without changing bytes
frontier.next_probe: enumerate P1/P2->C shapes under the constraint map banked in evidence s3 (front-end fold, cse canon_reg/qty-fold in the preamble2 block, flow uncounted deletion all kill same-block cancellation); measure each with sandbox + .lreg refs

frontier.hypothesis: The original reached addiu with only 3 visible out2 refs because some OTHER pseudo's flow stats differed by one; small statement-placement shifts near the preamble2 boundary (tbl def spelling, i re-init, a1/a2 advance forms) move one-insn live-lengths and may open a window where 3-ref out2 still lands s6
frontier.mechanism: the s5/s6 outcome sits on an exact pri tie (1702.13) - one-insn live shifts are full levers
frontier.next_probe: keep the floor-1 structure, sweep single-statement placements/spellings of tbl/i/a1/a2/stptr2 with the pa4-read re-init, sandbox each; also re-run the sweep with the banked sym-K tbl refs+2 chain

frontier.hypothesis: If both die, the residual is a one-insn spelling-class question (move vs addiu of the same value) suitable for a precise ruling-request on whether any sanctioned construct may supply the out2 ref
frontier.mechanism: the constraint map proves the ref and the bytes cannot come from the same honest statement in the preamble2 block
frontier.next_probe: only after frontier 1-2 are measured dead; cite the s3 constraint map in the ruling question
